title: Recent advances in preparation and applications of white circularly polarized luminescent materials
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00410A, Tutorial Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pei Zhao, Hai-Yan Lu, Chuan-Feng Chen
White circularly polarized luminescence merges white emission with chiroptical activity. This Review highlights polymer-based, multicomponent-doped, and single-component WCPL materials, focusing on design strategies, synthesis, and applications.
